## Where did you run it?

<!-- A customer meeting, an internal workshop, a conference demo, a reproduction
     against your own Azure AI Foundry tenant, or just reading along locally.
     Rough is fine — "showed it in a 30-minute internal session" is a real answer. -->

## What did you run?

<!-- Offline only (`cost-router hero`, the published demo, `cost-router experiment
     run ...`), or a credentialed run against your own deployments? Which commands
     got you there, and on which Python? -->

## What happened?

<!-- Please include the parts that did not work: an install that failed, a gate
     that refused, a document that was wrong, a step you had to guess at. Reports
     of things going badly are more useful here than reports of things going well. -->

## Did you have to change anything to make it fit?

<!-- Config, rate card, workload, policy, timeouts — anything you had to adapt
     before it matched your situation. -->

---

**Please do not paste** tenant identifiers, endpoint hostnames, deployment names
you consider private, prompt or response text, or anything from a billing
statement. This issue is public, and nothing in this repository needs them.
